Andrea
HR Onboarding Specialist

An onboarding experience for new employees. Simply change the deck and the branding to customize.

Get started

Nathan
Customer Service Coach

Handling difficult customer service calls? Nathan is an experienced Customer Service Supervisor. Let him coach you to brush up your skills.

Get started

David
Interviewer

David screens candidates for an Assistant Manager role at a family restaurant. Apply now!

Get started

Margo
Receptionist

Visiting? Margo takes your name and alerts your host that you’ve arrived. Simply change the branding, connect to Slack and your internal directory.

Get started

Phishing
Phishing Awareness Expert

Train employees to recognize phishing attempts and respond safely before an attack puts company data at risk.

Get started

GDPR
Security Expert

Help employees understand the rules of GDPR and how to handle personal data responsibly.

Get started

Theo
Trivia Master

Can you beat Theo at his own game as he asks some tough trivia questions?

Get started

Julian
Casting Director

See if you’ve got what it takes to get to Hollywood with this interactive test of your acting skills. Are you ready for your close-up?

Get started
